title: Hot Cocoa Mix

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 13.4. No price change (still $5.03), and no promotion planned. The 'Back-to-school season' event has shown no consistent lift: noise-adjusted effect is x1.0, with only one past week (2025-08-25) showing a meaningful spike (x1.38), but that's not replicated in 2026. Recent weeks (2026-08-03, 2026-08-10) show no lift. The classical uplift model correctly suggests no change. No evidence of pantry-loading risk (no prior promotion). The baseline already reflects seasonal trends and noise. No driver justifies a multiplier >1.0 or <1.0.
